plugins.name: clew
plugins.description: Index a C, C++, Rust or Python repository into a queryable graph — symbols, call edges, callbacks, threads, locks, dataflow, requirement links and prose — and serve it over MCP. Requires the clew-trace package on PATH and the doxygen binary. Harvests symbols from C, C++, Rust, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, shell and CMake; registers YAML, JSON, Perl and Make files by name without parsing them.
